2.251.12
MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataRegion
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataRegion element specifies a map data region as the source
for the map polygons (specified by MapPolygon elements) for the parent layer. This element is
optional. This element is ignored if the value of the MapPolygonLayer.MapPolygons element is
specified.
The MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataRegion cannot be present if either of the following elements
is present:
MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataSet

MapPolygonLayer.MapShapefile

The MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataRegion element is of type MapSpatialDataRegion.
Following is the parent element of the MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataRegion element.
Parent elements
MapPolygonLayer
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapPolygonLayer.MapSpatialDataRegion
element.
 <xsd:element name="MapSpatialDataRegion" type="MapSpatialDataRegionType"
              minOccurs="0" />
